input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay obligation, shortfall charge or volume cap on Sparkling. Fees are payable only for the licence granted and services actually ordered: Section 11 simply requires payment of the Fee Schedule fees; Section 2 charges additional fees only if Sparkling elects to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations; and maintenance under Section 10 runs on a "renewable one-year term" rather than a multi-year committed term. Sparkling also retains an unconditional right to terminate on ninety (90) days' notice (Section 17(b)), so there is no locked-in spend. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "take or pay", "shortfall", "volume" and "non-refundable" returned no customer-side commitment language. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered services only), so no redline is warranted.
